info.title: API Reference
info.description:
## Introduction

Welcome to the Qwilr Public API documentation. With our API you'll be
able to generate Qwilr Pages programmatically. This means you can
generate custom quotes, create pages when someone fills out a form,
or anything else.

Our API is organized around [REST](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_State_Transfer).
All calls made are to your live account.

If you're looking for help with the Qwilr app you can find that in our
[help documentation](https://help.qwilr.com/).

If you have any questions about our API, please get in touch at
[help@qwilr.com](mailto:help@qwilr.com).

tags.name: Pages
tags.description:
A page object is a page in the Qwilr app. With the API you can list your
pages, and you can create, read and update a page by sending a JSON
object.

tags.name: Blocks
tags.description:
Block objects correspond to blocks in the Qwilr UI. Pages and templates are
composed of a series of blocks. The Qwilr API allows you to get the list of
saved blocks from your account.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Webhooks allow you to subscribe and unsubscribe from events on your Qwilr account.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Miscellaneous operations concerning your Qwilr account.

tags.name: Taxes
tags.description:
A tax object is a quote tax definition in your Qwilr account. With the API
you can create, read, update and delete your taxes, and use their IDs when
you build a quote.

tags.name: Payment Gateways
tags.description:
A payment gateway object is a Qwilr Pay gateway in your Qwilr account. With
the API you can list your gateways, and use the ID of a gateway as the
`gatewayId` in the payment settings of a page.

get.description:
Returns the pages in your account, with the newest page first. The endpoint returns the pages in sets, and gives you a cursor for the next set. It returns only the pages that the owner of the access token can see. It never returns deleted pages. It does not return archived pages, unless you pass `tags=archived`.

Each result is a summary of a page, not a full page. A summary has no blocks, acceptance data or payment settings. [Get a page](/api-reference/#pages/get-a-page) to read those fields.

To read every page in your account, send the `nextCursor` value from your last response as the `cursor` parameter, and keep all of the other parameters the same. Repeat this until `nextCursor` is `null`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of pages in each set of results. Default is `25`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor that points to the next set of results. Use the `nextCursor` value from your last response. Omit this parameter to get the first set of results. The API rejects a cursor that is not valid, or a cursor from a response that used a different `sortDirection`, with a `400`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Returns only the pages that have one of these [statuses](https://help.qwilr.com/article/578-dashboard-page-statuses). Give the statuses as a comma-separated list. `draft` selects the pages that you have not published. `live` and `accepting` are exclusive: `live` does not select a page that is `accepting`.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Returns only the pages that have **all** of these tags. Give the tags as a comma-separated list. Tags are case-sensitive. An archived page has the `archived` tag, so `tags=archived` returns your archived pages and only those pages.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Returns only the pages that are directly inside this folder. The endpoint does not search sub-folders. Omit this parameter to return the pages in all folders.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Returns only the pages that this user owns.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sorts the results by the time each page was created. `desc` puts the newest page first, and `asc` puts the oldest page first. Default is `desc`.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Adds more fields to each page in the results. Give the field names as a comma-separated list.

post.description: Creates a page from saved blocks or template.

name.description: Title of the page, visible as the browser page title.

published.description: Whether the page is publically available; `false` means the page will be in [Draft status](https://help.qwilr.com/article/578-dashboard-page-statuses). Default is `false`.

tags.description: The tags for your page. Tags are case-sensitive.

ownerId.description: ID of the user that should own the page. If not specified, the owner of the access token will be the owner of the page.

get.description: Returns one page, with all of its fields. To get many pages at the same time, use [List pages](/api-reference/#pages/list-pages).

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The ID of the page to get.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Adds more fields to the page in the response. Give the field names as a comma-separated list.

put.description: Updates the `published` field of the page, its link `expiry` settings and its Qwilr Pay `paymentSettings`. Supplying `blocks` performs a full content replacement of the page from saved blocks (the page keeps its id and links); only pages created via the saved-block method are supported. Supplying `folderId` moves the page to that folder. The move runs before the other changes. If a later change fails, the page stays in the new folder. Supplying `addTags` adds those tags to the page after the move. An invalid tag rejects the request before any change. To move or tag an accepted or disabled page, send only `folderId`, `skipIfTemplateDefaultFolder` and `addTags`.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: The ID of the page to update.

substitutions.description: Page-wide variable substitutions applied when replacing content. Only applied when `blocks` is supplied; overridden by any matching block-level substitutions.

blocks.description: Saved blocks to replace the page's content with. When supplied, the page's existing content is fully replaced with these blocks. At least one block must be provided.

folderId.description: The ID of the folder to move the page to. The owner of the access token must be able to view the folder. If the API cannot find the folder, it returns a `404` with the type `FolderNotFound`.

skipIfTemplateDefaultFolder.description: Send this field only with `folderId`. When it is `true` and the template of the page has a default output folder that is the root, or that exists and is not `folderId`, the API does not move the page. It returns a `409` with the type `PAGE_USES_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT_FOLDER` and applies no other field in the request. A request with only `folderId` and this field can move an accepted or disabled page.

addTags.description: Tags to add to the page. The page keeps its other tags, and a tag that the page already has does not change. The API trims each tag. It returns a `400` for an empty tag, a tag longer than 30 characters, or the reserved tags `archived`, `starred` and `templateqwilr` in any letter case, and then adds no tag.

200.description: The page has been successfully updated

409.description: The API did not update the page. The type `PAGE_USES_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT_FOLDER` means that the template of the page has a different default output folder (see `skipIfTemplateDefaultFolder`). The type `ConflictError` means that the page changed during the request, or that an acceptance is in progress.

get.description: Retrieve a list of saved blocks from your account, with block names. Useful in developer workflow for mapping block names to saved block IDs.
Returns the quote tax definitions in your account. Each tax has an ID, a name and a rate.

post.description: Creates a quote tax definition in your account. Qwilr generates the `id` of the tax and returns it in the response. You can also supply your own `id`, for example an ID from another system. The request body gives the rules for an `id` that you supply. You cannot change the `id` after you create the tax. To use a different ID, delete the tax and create a new one. Keep the `id` from the response, because you use it to refer to the tax in other parts of the API.

patch.description: Updates a quote tax definition. The endpoint changes only the fields that you supply. You must supply `name`, `rate`, or both. You cannot change the `id` of a tax. To use a different ID, delete the tax and create a new one.

parameters.name: taxId
parameters.description: The ID of the tax to update.

delete.description: Deletes a quote tax definition from your account.

parameters.name: taxId
parameters.description: The ID of the tax to delete.

get.description: Returns the Qwilr Pay payment gateways in your account. Each gateway has an ID and a name. Use the `id` of a gateway as the `gatewayId` in the payment settings of a page.

get.summary: Get a list of all webhook subscriptions
get.description: Allows you to retrieve a list of all the webhook subscriptions that you have created using the create webhook subscription endpoint.

post.description: Creates a new webhook subscription to an event type. New events will be sent to the defined `targetUrl`. You should store the `id` field returned in case you want to cancel the subscription later on.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is accepted.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is partially accepted. Your page has been accepted by one or more accepters but not all accepters.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is "accepted" as part of [previewing the acceptance process](https://help.qwilr.com/article/175-getting-documents-accepted#process).

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is viewed for the first time. It is intended to capture public page viewers while excluding views by logged-in Qwilr users. We also provide an [IP filtering feature](https://help.qwilr.com/article/315-filtering-out-internal-views) to exclude other internal views, if required.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is viewed (regardless of whether it is the first view or a subsequent view). It is intended to capture public page viewers while excluding views by logged-in Qwilr users. We also provide an [IP filtering feature](https://help.qwilr.com/article/315-filtering-out-internal-views) to exclude other internal views, if required.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is set to live from draft.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

requestBody.description: Webhook callback that fires when a page is set to live from declined.

200.description: Return this if your server accepts the callback. This acknowledgement should be made before the timeout of 30s. If the timeout occurs, the callback will be retried, up to 5 times.

delete.description: Cancels a webhook event subscription using the `id` field that was returned when the webhook subscription was created.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The id returned when your subscription was created

get.description: Retrieve the list of users from your account, with roles and team names. Useful for specifying the `ownerId` when creating a page.

bearerAuth.description:
All API requests need to be authenticated with your account's access token. You can find
your access token in the [Qwilr API Settings](https://app.qwilr.com/#/settings/api).

Your access token allows anyone to access your Qwilr pages and account. Be sure to keep it
secret! Do not share your access tokens in any public spaces such as your source repository
client-side code, and so forth.

**When making a request:**

- Use your access token with bearer authentication in the headers.
For example: `Authorization: Bearer fakeaccesstoken`
- Send all requests over [HTTPS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTPS)

PageSummary.description: A summary of a page, returned by the list pages endpoint. A summary has fewer fields than a full page: it has no blocks, acceptance data or payment settings. This keeps the response small when you list many pages. [Get a page](/api-reference/#pages/get-a-page) to read the other fields.

name.description: The name of the page. The browser shows it as the page title.

status.description: The [status](https://help.qwilr.com/article/578-dashboard-page-statuses) of the page. `accepting` means that some, but not all, of the accepters accepted the page.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the page was created.

tags.description: The tags on the page. Tags are case-sensitive.

folderId.description: The ID of the folder that holds the page. It is `null` when the page is at the top level of the dashboard.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the page. The API omits this field only for an old page that has no owner.

metadata.description: The metadata on the page. The API returns this field only when you pass `expand=metadata`. It is `null` when the page has no metadata.

links.description: The URLs of the page. Some URLs are for your buyers, and some are for your team. If your account has a custom domain, the URLs for your buyers use that domain.

publicUrl.description: The main URL of the page, which you send to your buyers.

editorUrl.description: The URL that opens the page in the Qwilr editor.

collaboratorUrl.description: The internal URL that your team uses to work on the page together. It is `null` when the page has no collaborator URL.

pdfUrl.description: The URL that downloads a PDF version of the page. Use it when you must have the page as a file. You do not usually send it to your buyers. Send them `publicUrl`, which is the interactive page.

PageList.description: One set of results from the list pages endpoint.

data.description: The pages in this set of results. They are in the order that `sortDirection` sets.

nextCursor.description: The cursor that points to the next set of results. To get the next set, send this value as the `cursor` parameter and keep all of the other parameters the same. It is `null` when there are no more results.

SplashSettings.description: Configures background media settings for Text and Splash blocks. Only relevant if you want to customise Text and Splash blocks. Including this field when the block is not a Splash or Text block is invalid and will result in an error.

imageUrl.description: URL of the background image. Ensure the image is publicly available to the Internet.

videoUrl.description: URL of the background video. We currently only support YouTube videos. Ensure the video is publicly available to the Internet.

PostAcceptance.description: Configures a post-acceptance redirect for the page; accepters will be redirected upon accepting the page. If not provided, it will not be enabled.

enabled.description: Whether or not the post-acceptance action is enabled for the page. Default is `true`.

url.description: The URL that the accepter will be redirected to upon acceptance. The URL must have a protocol specified and it must be one of `http`, `https`, or no protocol specified and will be defaulted to `https`. Other protocols will be rejected with an error on page creation.

continueLabel.description: The label that will be used on the button to perform the post-acceptance action. Default is `Continue`.

AcceptBlockSettings.description: Configures settings for the accept block. Only relevant if you want to customise your accept block. Including this field when the block is not an Accept block is invalid and will result in an error.

TaxIds.description: The IDs of the taxes to apply to the whole quote. Ignore this field for non Quote block types. Each ID must be the ID of a tax in your account. Create and manage your taxes with the [Taxes endpoints](/api-reference/#taxes). The API rejects an unknown ID with a `400`. This field replaces the taxes that are already there: omit the field to keep the taxes of the saved block, send `[]` to remove all of the taxes, or send IDs to apply exactly those taxes.

QuoteSettings.description: Settings for the quote block. Only relevant if you want to customise your quote block. Ignore this field for non Quote block types.

selectionType.description: The [selection type/mode](/docs/guides/quote-data-lifecycle#quote-block-fundamentals) of the quote. Default is `combined`.

selectionRequired.description: If quote selection is enabled, this specifies if a selection must be made. Default is `false`.

currency.description: Currency for the quote block. If not specified then the currency of the saved quote block will be retained.

showTotalDiscount.description: Whether the total discount is shown. Default is `false`.

showTaxTotals.description: Whether the total tax is shown. Default is `false`.

showTotalExcludingTax.description: Whether the total amount excluding tax is shown. Default is `false`.

quoteDiscount.description: The discount to apply to the total quote price.

FeaturesList.description: For plan cards, the features that will be listed below the plan card.

Metadata.description: Data you provide, that will be returned as part of all Webhooks.

FixedCostLineItem.title: Fixed cost line item
FixedCostLineItem.description: A fixed cost line item, with a description and pricing information

description.description: The text description of the line item

unitPrice.description: The per unit price of the line item

unitLabel.description: The per unit label of the line item

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item

quantityRange.description: A range your client can choose the quantity from (when you don't want to provide a fixed quantity). This field is optional

taxExempt.description: Whether the line item is exempt from tax. Default is `false`.

optional.description: Whether the line item is optional. Default is `false`.

selected.description: Whether an optional line item is selected by default. Default is `false`.

lineItemDiscount.description: The discount to apply to the total line item price.

billingSchedule.description: Set the billing frequency, whether it's a one-off or recurring. Default is `one-off`.

recommended.description: For plan cards, whether it is highlighted as recommended. Default is `false`.

featuresList.description: For plan cards, the features that will be listed below the plan card.

metadata.description: Customer's metadata sent along with the request

TextLineItem.title: Text line item
TextLineItem.description: A text line item, with a description

description.description: The text description of the line item

metadata.description: Customer's metadata sent along with the request

QuoteSection.description: A Quote section containing a group of line items or plan cards.

displayMode.description: Display the quote section as a [table](https://help.qwilr.com/article/741-creating-tables-in-the-quote-block) or [plans](https://help.qwilr.com/article/740-creating-pricing-cards-in-the-quote-block). Default is `table`.

itemSingleSelect.description: Whether only one line item or plan card in this section can be selected at a time. Default is `false` for tables, `true` for plans.

description.description: The text description of the section.

lineItems.description: An array of line items (or plan cards) for the section.

showSubtotal.description: Whether the subtotal amount is shown or not. Default is `true`.

showUnitPrice.description: Whether or not to show the unit price column. Default is `true`.

showQuantity.description: Whether or not to show the quantity column. Default is `true`.

showCost.description: Whether or not to show the cost column. Default is `true`.

selected.description: Whether the quote section is pre-selected. Only relevant when the quote's selectionType is 'multi' or 'single'. Default is `false`.

selectionRequired.description: Whether this quote section must be selected. Only relevant when the quote's selectionType is 'multi' or 'single'". Default is `false`.

sectionDiscount.description: The discount to apply to the total section price.

showFeatures.description: Whether the feature lists are shown below each plan card. Default is `true`.

groupItemsByBillingSchedule.description: Whether the plan cards are grouped by billing frequency. Default is `false`.

metadata.description: Customer's metadata sent along with the request

TextVariableSubstitutions.title: Text Variable Substitutions
TextVariableSubstitutions.description: A text substitution. Replaces the variable with a plain text value.

RepeatingVariableSubstitutions.title: Repeating Variable Substitutions
RepeatingVariableSubstitutions.description: A repeating variable substitution. Content is repeated for each entry in the array.

BlockSubstitutions.description: Mapping of variable API reference keys to substitution values used inside a block.

SavedBlockData.description: A single saved block to add to a page, identified by its saved-block `id` with optional per-block customisation. Used both when creating a page from saved blocks and when replacing a page's content via update.

foldable.description: Foldable settings for the block. Folding is only possible with non Quote block types. Don't set this field for your Quote block.

enabled.description: The block has the fold/unfold button shown if the property is `true`, otherwise the ability to fold/unfold is disabled. Default is `false`.

isFolded.description: The block is folded by default if the property is `true`, otherwise it's expanded. Default is `false`.

label.description: The label shown when folding is enabled. Default is `Show / Hide`.

quoteSections.description: An array of sections in a saved Quote block. Only relevant if you want to customise your quote block. Ignore this field for non Quote block types.

AcceptTemplateSettings.description: Configures settings for the accept block in the template being used. Only relevant if you have an accept block. Setting this without an accept block in the template will result in an error.

PageSubstitutions.description: Mapping of variable API reference keys to substitution values used throughout the page. The values can be overwritten if the same keys are defined in the block-level substitutions.

Expiry.description: The [link expiry settings](https://help.qwilr.com/article/579-set-a-page-to-expire) for the page. When you enable expiry, the link of the page stops working after the number of days that you set, and the status of the page becomes `declined`. The count of days starts when you publish the page. A draft page keeps the setting until you publish it.

enabled.description: Whether link expiry is enabled for the page. Default is `false`.

expireAfterDays.description: The number of days after you publish the page before its link stops working. This field is necessary when `enabled` is `true`. Give a whole number from 1 to 365.

postAcceptance.description: Post-acceptance details for the accepter. Null if post-acceptance not enabled for accepter.

auditTrailPdf.description: URL for the audit trail PDF download. Please note that it might take a few minutes for the PDF to be available after the Qwilr page is accepted.

agreementAuditTrailPdf.description: URL for the agreement audit trail PDF download. Please note that it might take a few minutes for the PDF to be available after the Qwilr page is accepted.

RecurringSettings.description: One schedule for a recurring payment (subscription). It sets the anchor date, the start date, the end date, the free trial and the changes in price.

anchorDate.description: The date that the billing cycle of the subscription starts from.

endDate.description: When the subscription ends. Give a number of billing cycles, where `null` means that the subscription does not end, or give a date.

freeTrialDays.description: The number of days in the free trial. Use `0` for no free trial.

prorateChanges.description: Whether Qwilr calculates a part-period amount when the subscription changes in the middle of a billing cycle.

RecurringInvoiceConfig.description: The invoice settings for recurring payments.

enabled.description: Whether Qwilr sends an invoice for each recurring payment.

daysUntilDue.description: The number of days after Qwilr sends the invoice before the payment is due.

paymentMethods.description: The payment methods that the buyer can use to pay the invoice.

RecurringConfig.description: The settings for recurring payments (subscriptions) on the page.

enabled.description: Whether recurring payments are enabled on the page.

defaultSettings.description: The schedule that the page uses for each billing frequency, unless `settings` sets another one.

settings.description: The schedules for specific billing frequencies. Each key is a billing frequency, for example `monthly`. A schedule here replaces `defaultSettings` for that frequency.

PaymentSettings.description: The Qwilr Pay settings for the page.

enabled.description: Whether Qwilr Pay is enabled on the page.

gatewayId.description: The ID of the payment gateway that takes the payments for the page. It is `null` when the page has no gateway.

requireOnAccept.description: Whether the buyer must pay at the same time as they accept the page.

discoverable.description: Whether the page shows the payment option to the buyer before the buyer accepts it.

customBusinessName.description: The business name that the payment screen shows. It replaces the default name of your account.

extraInformation.description: More information for the buyer on the payment screen.

payLaterButtonText.description: Your own label for the pay later button.

partialPaymentConfig.description: The settings that let the buyer pay part of the total amount first.

enabled.description: Whether the buyer can pay part of the total amount first.

amount.description: The amount that the buyer pays first. It is a fixed amount or a percentage of the total, which `kind` sets.

kind.description: Whether `amount` is a fixed amount or a percentage of the total.

name.description: The name of the page. The browser shows it as the page title.

status.description: The [status](https://help.qwilr.com/article/578-dashboard-page-statuses) of the page. `accepting` means that some, but not all, of the accepters accepted the page.

tags.description: The tags on the page. Tags are case-sensitive.

folderId.description: The ID of the folder that holds the page. It is `null` when the page is at the top level of the dashboard.

metadata.description: The metadata on the page. The API returns this field only when you pass `expand=metadata`. It is `null` when the page has no metadata.

links.description: The URLs of the page. Some URLs are for your buyers, and some are for your team. If your account has a custom domain, the URLs for your buyers use that domain.

collaboratorUrl.description: The internal URL that your team uses to work on the page together.

editorUrl.description: The URL that opens the page in the Qwilr editor.

publicUrl.description: The main URL of the page, which you send to your buyers.

pdfUrl.description: The URL that downloads a PDF version of the page. Use it when you must have the page as a file. You do not usually send it to your buyers. Send them `publicUrl`, which is the interactive page.

agreementPdfUrl.description: The URL of the PDF version of the agreement on the page.

ownerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the page.

expiry.description: The link expiry settings for the page. `enabled` is `false` when the link of the page does not expire. The API returns `expireAfterDays` and `expiresOn` only when expiry is enabled, and it returns `expiresOn` only after you publish the page.

enabled.description: Whether link expiry is enabled for the page.

expireAfterDays.description: The number of days after you publish the page before its link stops working.

expiresOn.description: The date and time when the link of the page stops working.

PaymentSettingsUpdate.description: The changes to make to the Qwilr Pay settings of the page. All of the fields are optional, and the endpoint does not change a field that you omit. To switch payments on, send `enabled: true`. The page then needs a gateway, so send `gatewayId`, or omit it to use the default gateway of your account. Note: if you switch payments on for a page that has no gateway, the endpoint replaces all of the payment settings with the defaults of your account. It does not merge your values into them.

enabled.description: Whether Qwilr Pay is enabled on the page.

gatewayId.description: The ID of the payment gateway that takes the payments for the page. Omit it to use the default gateway of your account when you switch payments on.

requireOnAccept.description: Whether the buyer must pay at the same time as they accept the page.

discoverable.description: Whether the page shows the payment option to the buyer before the buyer accepts it.

customBusinessName.description: The business name that the payment screen shows. It replaces the default name of your account.

extraInformation.description: More information for the buyer on the payment screen.

payLaterButtonText.description: Your own label for the pay later button.

partialPaymentConfig.description: The settings that let the buyer pay part of the total amount first.

enabled.description: Whether the buyer can pay part of the total amount first.

amount.description: The amount that the buyer pays first. It is a fixed amount or a percentage of the total, which `kind` sets.

kind.description: Whether `amount` is a fixed amount or a percentage of the total.

id.description: The ID of the tax. Use this value to refer to the tax in other parts of the API.

name.description: The display name of the tax.

rate.description: The rate of the tax, as a percentage. It is `null` when the tax has no rate.

id.description: An optional ID for the tax. Supply your own ID, for example an ID from another system, to refer to the tax by a value that you control. If you omit this field, Qwilr generates an ID for you. The ID must be unique in your account. It must have 1 to 64 characters. Use letters, digits, `-` and `_` only, and start with a letter or a digit. You cannot change the ID after you create the tax. To use a different ID, delete the tax and create a new one.

name.description: The display name of the tax.

rate.description: The rate of the tax, as a percentage. Send `null` to create a tax with no rate.

UpdateTaxRequest.description: The changes to make to the tax. The endpoint changes only the fields that you supply. You must supply `name`, `rate`, or both.

name.description: The display name of the tax.

rate.description: The rate of the tax, as a percentage. Send `null` to remove the rate.

id.description: The ID of the payment gateway. Send this value as the `gatewayId` in the payment settings of a page, to take the payments for that page through this gateway.

name.description: The display name of the payment gateway.

BadRequest.description: Request has malformed data or invalid

Forbidden.description: No permission to access a resource

Conflict.description: Resource conflicts with an existing resource
